title: Jacob’s Burial and Joseph’s Death

questions.question: What did Joseph do when Jacob died?
questions.explanation: Genesis 50:1 (ESV): "Then Joseph fell on his father’s face and wept over him and kissed him." Grief mourns.

questions.question: Where was Jacob buried?
questions.explanation: Genesis 50:13 (ESV): "for his sons carried him to the land of Canaan and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah to the east of Mamre, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a possession for a burying place." Tomb honors.

questions.question: What did Joseph’s brothers fear after Jacob’s death?
questions.explanation: Genesis 50:15 (ESV): "When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, ‘It may be that Joseph will hate us and pay us back for all the evil that we did to him.’" Fear doubts.

questions.question: What did Joseph promise his brothers?
questions.explanation: Genesis 50:21 (ESV): "‘So do not fear; I will provide for you and your little ones.’ Thus he comforted them and spoke kindly to them." Assurance comforts.

questions.question: How old was Joseph when he died?
questions.explanation: Genesis 50:26 (ESV): "So Joseph died, being 110 years old. They embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt." Life ends.

key_verse_text: ‘As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to bring it about that many people should be kept alive, as they are today.’
